# TachiReel

> TachiReel is a gentle photo and short-video social app for sharing everyday moments with a small circle. Public help content is available without an account.

## Public pages

- [Home](http://localhost:8081/): Product overview, safety posture, and getting started calls to action.
- [Help & Support](http://localhost:8081/support): Searchable help centre with articles about posts, Reelyx, privacy, teen safety, messages, attachments and voice support.

## Help articles

- [Getting started](http://localhost:8081/support/articles/getting-started)
- [Community guidelines](http://localhost:8081/support/articles/community-guidelines)
- [Post review](http://localhost:8081/support/articles/post-review)
- [Reelyx](http://localhost:8081/support/articles/reelyx)
- [Privacy](http://localhost:8081/support/articles/privacy)
- [Teen safety](http://localhost:8081/support/articles/teen-safety)
- [Messages](http://localhost:8081/support/articles/messages)
- [Attachments](http://localhost:8081/support/articles/attachments)
- [Voice support](http://localhost:8081/support/articles/voice-support)

## Discovery

- Sitemap: http://localhost:8081/sitemap.xml
- Robots: http://localhost:8081/robots.txt

Private feeds, conversations, guardian consent links and the admin workspace are intentionally excluded from indexes.
